meta.title: Student Success OS
meta.description: School roster, roles and families in one place.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in with your school account.
signIn.invalid: That email and password don't match. Please try again.
signIn.tagline: One place for your school's students, staff and families.

join.title: Join your school
join.subtitle: Your account isn't linked to a school yet. Enter the join code or invitation code your school gave you.
join.invalidCode: We couldn't find that code. Check it and try again.
join.codeUsed: This invitation has already been used or has expired.
join.invalidRole: Please choose one of the roles below.
join.chooseSubtitle: How are you connected to the school? The school will confirm your request.

roleHint.parent: My child studies at this school.

join.pendingBody: Your request to join {school} as {role} has been sent. A school administrator will review it soon.
join.pendingNext: You'll get access as soon as it's approved. You can sign out and come back later.

schools.title: Choose a school
schools.subtitle: Your account belongs to more than one school.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's an overview of {school}.
dashboard.pendingClaims: {count, plural, =0 {No requests awaiting approval} one {# request awaiting approval} other {# requests awaiting approval}}
dashboard.noChildren: No students are linked to your account yet.
dashboard.noAccess: Your role doesn't include access to the school roster yet.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: Students, teachers and parents at {school}.
people.parentSubtitle: You can see the students linked to your account.
people.count: {count, plural, =0 {No people} one {# person} other {# people}}

errors.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

nudge.goalWeekly: Weekly check-in on your goal “{title}”: you are {progressPct}% of the way there. Deadline: {deadline}.

errors.already_decided: Someone has already decided this card.
errors.card_expired: This card has expired. A fresh proposal will follow the next recompute.
errors.stale_card: The student's track changed after this card was proposed. Dismiss it and wait for a fresh proposal.
errors.unknown_decider: Your account isn't linked to a person at this school.
errors.not_authorized: Your role can't decide this card.
errors.unsupported_card_type: This kind of card can only be dismissed for now.
errors.invalid_decision: That decision isn't possible. To change the track, use Edit and change at least one field.
errors.invalid_payload: Check the dates: the review date must be on or after the effective date, and the track must differ from the current one.
errors.invalid_form: The form was incomplete. Reload the page and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

inbox.title: Action inbox
inbox.subtitle: Proposals from the success engine. Nothing changes until a person approves, edits or dismisses them.
inbox.count: {count, plural, =0 {No open cards} one {# open card} other {# open cards}}
inbox.empty: No open cards. You're all caught up.
inbox.topFactors: Top factors (score points · against the grade cohort)
inbox.noEvidence: No risk evidence is attached to this card.
inbox.readOnly: Only a {role} or an admin can decide this card.
inbox.decidedTrack: {outcome, select, edited {Approved with edits} other {Approved}}: {student} moves to the {track} track.

risk.title: Risk explanation
risk.subtitle: How the score is built: every factor's contribution, compared with the student's grade cohort.
risk.totalHint: Contributions add up exactly to the score.
risk.explainer: Each factor's risk (0–100) is multiplied by its weight; factors without data are left out and the remaining weights are rescaled. “Against cohort” shows the points above (+) or below (−) a typical student in the same grade.
risk.empty: No risk score yet. It appears after the first recompute with grades or attendance.

profile.title: Student
profile.noOpenCards: No open action cards for this student.

trackHistory.title: Track history
trackHistory.subtitle: Every track assignment, newest first. A track only changes when a person approves a card.
trackHistory.empty: No track assignments yet — the student is on the default Growth track.
trackHistory.decidedBy: {status, select, edited {Approved with edits} other {Approved}} by {by} · {at}

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Escalation runs teacher → advisor → parent; each rung has an SLA to acknowledge.

tutor.title: AI tutor
tutor.subtitle: Pick a subject and a way of working, then ask your question. The tutor guides you to the answer rather than just giving it.
tutor.subject: Subject
tutor.placeholder: Type your question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
tutor.disclaimer: The tutor can make mistakes. Check important answers with your teacher.
tutor.noSubjects: You are not enrolled in any class yet, so there is no subject to open the tutor for. Ask your school to add you to your classes.

socratic.label: Guide me
socratic.hint: Questions that lead you to the answer

concept.label: Explain a concept
concept.hint: A clear explanation of an idea

worked_example.label: Worked example
worked_example.hint: A similar problem solved step by step

unavailable.title: The tutor is unavailable right now
unavailable.body: We can't reach the tutor service at the moment. Your classes and grades are unaffected — please try again a little later.

errors.unavailable: The tutor couldn't be reached. Your message was kept — try sending it again in a moment.
errors.session_expired: This conversation has ended. Your next message starts a new one.
errors.pii_blocked: Your message wasn't sent because it seems to contain personal details (like a name, phone number or email). Remove them and try again.
errors.rate_limited: You're sending messages quickly. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.invalid: That message couldn't be sent. Check it and try again.

mastery.title: Concept mastery
mastery.subtitle: Pick a class to see which concepts it is struggling with. Mastery is estimated from students' work with the AI tutor, so it only appears for concepts a student has actually practised.

noClasses.title: No classes yet
noClasses.body: This school has no classes set up, so there is nothing to show. Classes are created in the school's setup.

noStudents.title: No students in this class
noStudents.body: Nobody is enrolled in this class yet, so there is no mastery to show.

unavailable.title: Mastery is unavailable right now
unavailable.body: We can't reach the AI service that holds mastery data at the moment. Nothing has been lost — please try again a little later.

empty.title: No mastery data for this class yet
empty.body: Mastery only exists after students use the AI tutor. No student in this class has practised a concept with the tutor yet, so there is nothing to measure — this does not mean they are behind.

summary.title: Where {className} is weakest
summary.subtitle: Concepts ranked by class average, weakest first. Averages count only students who have been assessed on the concept.

grid.title: Students × concepts
grid.unassessed: {count, plural, one {# student has} other {# students have}} no tutor attempts yet.
grid.note: "No data" means not yet assessed, not zero mastery.
